content: The following organizations are dedicated to supporting individuals with cystic fibrosis or conducting research into this hereditary condition, which primarily affects the lungs and digestive system, leading to progressive disability and, in some cases, early mortality: Australia Cystic Fibrosis Australia (CFA): This is a national organization in Australia that focuses on raising awareness and providing education about cystic fibrosis through advocacy and research initiatives. Europe Cystic Fibrosis Trust: A UK-based charity that provides research, information, and care for individuals living with cystic fibrosis. European Cystic Fibrosis Society (ECFS): Based in Denmark, this organization comprises clinicians and scientists who are actively involved in research, care, and collaboration related to cystic fibrosis. Association Grégory Lemarchal: A French organization dedicated to raising awareness and funding research for cystic fibrosis. It is named after Grégory Lemarchal, a French singer and winner of Star Academy, who had cystic fibrosis. North America Canadian Cystic Fibrosis Foundation (CCFF): A Canadian health organization that funds research and care for individuals with cystic fibrosis. Cystic Fibrosis Foundation (CFF): A U.S.-based non-profit organization committed to finding a cure and controlling cystic fibrosis through research and support. Cystic Fibrosis Reaching Out Foundation: A U.S.-based network that provides information and support to individuals with cystic fibrosis and their families. Boomer Esiason Foundation: A U.S.-based organization that supports research aimed at finding a cure for cystic fibrosis. It also provides education and works to improve the quality of life for those affected by the disease. The foundation is named after former NFL quarterback Boomer Esiason, whose son Gunnar has cystic fibrosis. Lungs for Life Foundation: A U.S.-based organization focused on enhancing the quality of life for individuals with cystic fibrosis through assistive services, education, and research. Elizabeth Nash Foundation: A U.S.-based organization that emphasizes research, education, and patient support. It is named after scientist Elizabeth Nash. National Cystic Fibrosis Awareness Committee (NCFAC): A U.S.-based group that promotes public awareness of cystic fibrosis through an annual national observance dedicated to cystic fibrosis awareness. Rock CF Foundation: A U.S.-based non-profit organization that uses arts, entertainment, fashion, and fitness to raise awareness and funds for cystic fibrosis. It was founded by Emily Schaller. Liv for a Cure: A U.S.-based foundation dedicated to raising funds to support the fight against cystic fibrosis.
